findings.title: Preserve shipped pairings when the mapping run does no work
findings.problem: The populated, signed pairing map is replaced with an empty `pairs` object. The accompanying run report confirms zero calls, zero reviewed candidates, and zero attachments because the budget was $0. This removes existing diagram functionality rather than incrementally updating it, violating the rule against removing or weakening existing features.
findings.failure_scenario: A student reviewing a previously mapped item, such as question 12 with its potassium diagram and confirmed K value of 6.8, can no longer receive that pairing from the shipped map. Every other previously mapped item loses its attachment as well.
findings.fix: Restore the published map. Make a run that stops before doing any work leave published artifacts untouched. If the source-key change requires revalidation, complete that validation and publish a validated, signed replacement rather than overwriting all existing pairings with an empty result.

assessment: Do not merge: the zero-budget run deletes all previously shipped item-to-diagram pairings without producing replacements.
